info.title: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash
info.description:
MiniMax (`type=35`) channel Chat Completions capability documentation. The unified API endpoint is `/v1/chat/completions`. The platform gateway forwards requests to the upstream provider `POST /v1/text/chatcompletion_v2`, using an OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible request and response structure.

`MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` supports a 1,000,000-token context window with text, image, and video inputs. Thinking is always on and cannot be disabled; tune its depth with `reasoning_effort`. The same model is also available through `POST /v1/messages` (Anthropic Messages-compatible) and native `POST /v1/responses` (OpenAI Responses-compatible); see the Responses API page for how `reasoning.effort` maps to the same setting.

This document describes only the field subset that the platform gateway reliably passes through: `model`, `messages`, `temperature`, `top_p`, `max_tokens`, `reasoning_effort`, `stream`.

post.description: Call the MiniMax-M3.1-Flash OpenAI-compatible chat model via the baze platform. The model supports a 1,000,000-token context window with text, image, and video inputs. Thinking is always on; tune its depth with `reasoning_effort`. The same model is also available through `POST /v1/messages` and `POST /v1/responses`.

200.description: Success. Non-streaming returns OpenAI-compatible JSON; streaming returns an OpenAI-compatible SSE event stream.

schema.description: SSE data stream. Each `data:` event can be parsed as an OpenAI Chat Completions Chunk; the stream typically ends with `data: [DONE]`.

text/event-stream.description: Streaming chunks also carry `requested_model` and `resolved_model`. If the client disconnects before the stream completes, the platform stops forwarding chunks; without a full usage report, `usage` stays unknown (never filled with `0`). Do not count omitted usage as zero cost.

stream_interrupted.summary: Usage stays unknown when the stream is interrupted (never 0)
stream_interrupted.description: Client disconnected before the stream finished: received chunks contain no final usage and no closing usage chunk will arrive; usage stays unknown.

unsupported_parameter.summary: Explicit error when passing an unsupported parameter (never silently ignored)

error.message: Model MiniMax-M3.1-Flash does not support the parameter `enable_search`. The platform never silently ignores unsupported parameters; please remove it and retry.

json_schema_not_supported.summary: Explicit error when json_schema is not supported

error.message: Model MiniMax-M3.1-Flash does not support the `response_format` parameter (including `json_schema`); the platform never silently ignores it. Please remove it and retry.

BearerAuth.description: Pass `Authorization: Bearer <token>` in the request header.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Higher values make output more random.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling threshold. Avoid tuning `temperature` and `top_p` at the same time.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of output tokens per reply. The model context window is 1,000,000 tokens, covering both input and output.

reasoning_effort.description: Thinking depth level. `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` always thinks and cannot disable it, so this field is the only way to control depth. Higher values produce more output tokens and longer waits. Defaults to `max` when omitted. On the Responses path, express the same setting with `reasoning.effort`.

stream.description: Whether to return results as an SSE event stream.

Role of the message sender

oneOf.description: Multimodal content blocks. MiniMax-M3.1-Flash supports text, image, and video inputs.

items.description: A multimodal content block. Use the `type` field to declare the block type, and populate only the field that matches that type.

type.description:
Content block type:
- `text`: Text block
- `image_url`: Image input
- `video_url`: Video input

image_url.description: Image input (when `type` is `image_url`). Maximum 10 MB per image. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WEBP.

url.description: Image URL or Base64 data URL.

detail.description: Controls image parsing resolution. Defaults to `default`. Higher values consume more tokens.

video_url.description: Video input (when `type` is `video_url`). Supported formats: MP4, AVI, MOV, MKV.

url.description: Video URL, Base64 data URL, or a Files API reference in the form `mm_file://{file_id}`. URL/Base64 videos: max 50 MB; Files API videos: max 512 MB.

detail.description: Controls video frame extraction resolution. Defaults to `default`.

fps.description: Video frame extraction rate. Defaults to 1, range [0.2, 5]. Higher values are more sensitive to visual changes but cost more tokens; lower values cost fewer tokens but may miss visual changes.

content.description: Message content. MiniMax-M3.1-Flash supports text, image, and video content blocks.

usage.description: Billing: both input and output tokens are billed. This model does not expose cache/reasoning token details; usage is subject to the platform bill. If a streaming request is interrupted before completion and no full usage is obtained, `usage` stays unknown (fields omitted) and is never filled with `0`.

requested_model.description: The original value of the `model` field in the request received by the platform, i.e. the requested model.

resolved_model.description: The model actually executed. Returns `null` when the upstream provider does not disclose the resolved model; the platform never fabricates this value.
